logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was measured by the standard shake-flask technique. Experiments were carried out at (37 +/- 1) C in triplicate. Approximately 3 mg (1 mg/mL) of each of the complexes was dissolved in MilliQ water (3 mL). The stock solution was divided into two parts (1 and 2 mL) in glass vials. One part of the solution (1 mL) was taken and the absorbance recorded to obtain the value of A0 after incubating at 37 C for 4 h. Octanol was added (2 mL) to another part of the solution and stirred at 37 C for 4 h. The water layer was separated and the absorbance was recorded to obtain A0 - A (Aoctanol).
